assertions.name: interior_max_outside_monotone_cone
assertions.source: Farkas certificate: φ=e_{k=4}−e_{k=3} is ≥0 on every non-decreasing basis function hence on the whole non-negative additive cone, but φ(miss)=miss(4)−miss(3)<0 on all three ladders ⇒ miss ∉ monotone cone (scope-(b), proved invariant). The missing channel is non-monotone (resonant); the fall is A_light-dependent (not separable). No fit.

description: R11-b (z2bn/round-11): Farkas certificate that the ladder-miss k=3 interior maximum is outside the monotone additive cone. For any basis of functions non-decreasing in k (const 1, k, C(k,2), C(k,3), k·A_light, …) the functional φ=e_{k=4}−e_{k=3} is ≥0, so ≥0 on the whole non-negative cone; but miss(4)−miss(3)<0 on all three (kα)+X ladders (n −1.46, d −4.19, t −5.37 MeV), so φ separates the miss from the cone. This is a scope-(b) exclusion (proved invariant monotone⇒φ≥0; the (k=3,k=4) decrease is the Farkas witness), not a scope-(a) near-miss: the missing binding channel is necessarily NON-monotone in k (a resonance). The fall ratio miss(4)/miss(3)=0.485/0.281/0.333 is A_light-dependent ⇒ not a separable parity factor; with R11-a's A_light-dependent k=2 envelope the miss is irreducibly 2D in (k,A_light). Redirects per-isotope closure to the operator-valued branching combiner / confinement SDP; formalize-first target = the R11-b order lemma. Consumes merged R10 witness (no recompute). No fit; magnitudes not interpreted.
